meaning: 〈人が〉〈危険・問題・相手など〉に立ち向かう,ぶつかっていく
example: She decided to confront her fears.

meaning: 〈人,人の言動〉をあざける,ばかにする
example: Don't mock someone for asking a question.
No one has the right to bully you.
He tried to threaten us into silence.
I hope to persuade her to stay.
There is no need to scold him.

meaning: (人に…について)不平を言う,泣きごとを言う,訴える
example: You can complain without being rude.
I object to being treated unfairly.

meaning: 〈危険・いやなもの〉を避ける,回避する(keep away from)
example: I try to avoid unnecessary arguments.

meaning: (危うく…から)逃げ出す,脱走する
example: She wanted to escape the noisy crowd.

meaning: 〈ある時間・場所・状態〉に近づく,接近する
example: He was afraid to approach the group.

meaning: (…と)相互に作用する,影響し合う
example: The game helps children interact with each other.
Good stories engage our emotions.
We must cooperate to solve this problem.
The siblings often compete for attention.

meaning: 〈人〉を手伝う,助力する,助ける
example: I'm happy to assist you.
They donate their spare clothes to charity.
She made a sacrifice for her family.

meaning: (危険・損害などから)…を守る,保護する
example: We want to protect the children from harm.

meaning: (危険などから)…を救う,救助(救出)する
example: The neighbors helped rescue the trapped dog.
We welcome you with open hearts.

meaning: (特に愛情を持って)…を抱き締める;(両腕・ひざなどで)…をぎゅっと締めつける
example: I wanted to hug my friend.
She leaned over to kiss his cheek.
He reached out to caress the dog's head.

meaning: (合図として)(…に)目くばせする,ウインクする
example: She would wink at me after each joke.

meaning: (承諾・あいさつ・合図などで)うなずく,会釈する
example: I saw him nod in agreement.

meaning: (挙手・礼砲などで)…に敬礼する
example: The soldiers salute their commander.

meaning: (気持ちや考えを表現するときの)身ぶり,手まね,しぐさ
example: She thanked us with a simple gesture.
The good news made him grin.

meaning: 顔をしかめる,怒った(不きげんな)顔をする;(…を)にらむ
example: He began to scowl at the interruption.

meaning: (…を)(目を大きく開いて)じっと見つめる,じろじろ見る,凝視する
example: Please don't stare at me.

meaning: (…を)じっと見つめる,凝視する
example: They gaze quietly at the stars.

meaning: (当惑・恥ずかしさのために)顔を赤らめる,赤面する
example: Compliments always make me blush.
She began to beam with pride.
The sad ending made her weep.

meaning: (喜び・悲しみ・苦痛などで)泣く,涙を流す
example: It's all right to cry.

meaning: (…に)(驚き・恐怖・怒りなどで)はっと息をのむ
example: The surprise made everyone gasp.

meaning: (恐怖・興奮・寒さなどで)〈身体・声などが〉震える
example: My hands tremble when I feel nervous.

meaning: (前後・上下・左右などに)…を振る,揺り動かす,揺する
example: She began to shake her head.

meaning: (通例小刻みに,またはわずかに)震える
example: His lips began to quiver.
I could feel my heartbeat getting faster.
The room filled with laughter.
The children began to giggle.

meaning: (人をばかにした)忍び笑い[擬声語]
example: I heard a snicker behind me.

meaning: (苦痛・悲嘆などで出す)うなり声,うめき声
example: He let out a groan of disappointment.

meaning: (悲しみ・苦痛などの)うめき[声]
example: A quiet moan came from the injured man.

meaning: 叫ぶ,大声を出す,どなる
example: Please don't shout at me.

meaning: (流れる水・そよぐ葉などの)ざわめき,かすかな音;(人の声の)ささやき,ぼそぼそいう声
example: A murmur of surprise spread through the room.

meaning: 静けさ,音がしないこと
example: We sat together in comfortable silence.
Her tone was gentle and reassuring.

meaning: (一般的な)姿勢;(特定の)姿勢,(モデルなどのとる)ポーズ
example: His relaxed posture made me feel welcome.
He began to smirk at my mistake.
He would sulk whenever he lost a game.
Try not to brood over the argument.
The story mixes everyday life with fantasy.
I woke up after a nightmare.
My memory of that day is clear.
She has a vivid recollection of their first meeting.
I value your opinion.
Her belief in me gave me confidence.

meaning: (心に浮かんだ)考え,思考;考えること
example: I have an idea that might help.

meaning: 洞察[力],眼識;(…を)見通す力
example: The conversation gave me insight into his feelings.
My first instinct was to help.
The activity encourages creativity.
I trust your judgment.

meaning: 知能,知力,理解力;知恵,そう明
example: Her intelligence impressed everyone.
The child wanted his father's attention.

meaning: (…に)気づいていること,(…であることに)気づいていること
example: The workshop increased our awareness of others' feelings.
After some reflection, I changed my mind.

meaning: (物欲に対し)精神的であること,精神性
example: She finds meaning through art and spirituality.

meaning: 良心,道義心,善悪を判断する力
example: My conscience told me to apologize.
An ethic of kindness guides their actions.
Patience is an important virtue.

meaning: (自分の信念・行為に対する)道義心,誠実,高潔
example: His sense of honor kept him honest.

meaning: (言動・服装などが)きちんとしていること
example: She treated everyone with basic decency.
The children care deeply about fairness.

meaning: (数量・程度・価値・大きさなどで)等しいこと,均等;(特に,権利・責任などにおいて)(…間の…の)平等
example: They believe in equality for everyone.
Personal bias can affect our judgment.

meaning: (…に対する不当な)先入観,偏見;(…に好意的な)先入観,えこひいき
example: Getting to know people can challenge prejudice.

meaning: (…に対する)憎しみ,憎悪,大嫌い
example: He refused to let hatred control him.
His aggression made the conversation difficult.
They spoke out against violence.

meaning: (…に対する)(強い)悪意,敵意,恨み
example: There was no malice in her words.
He hid the letter out of spite.
She chose forgiveness instead of vengeance.

meaning: (法律・社会・道徳上の)義務,約束
example: I felt an obligation to help.

meaning: (道徳・法律上の)義務,本分,義理
example: He felt it was his duty to tell the truth.
I will keep my promise to you.
My intention was to help, not upset you.
Helping others gives her a sense of purpose.

meaning: (義務・約束などの)遂行;(夢・希望などの)実現
example: The project marked the fulfillment of a dream.
We celebrated the accomplishment of our goal.
She was proud of her friend's success.
He struggled with the loss of his friend.
They accepted defeat with dignity.
Finishing the race was a personal triumph.
Fear became an obstacle to trying again.
The family supported each other through hardship.
Sharing the problem eased the burden.
The long wait put a strain on everyone.

meaning: 心の深い傷・トラウマ
example: She spoke carefully about the trauma she experienced.

meaning: (…に対する)(心身の)激しい苦しみ,苦悶(くもん)
example: His voice revealed his anguish.
I noticed her discomfort during the conversation.

meaning: 不満,不きげん,腹立たしさ
example: He made his displeasure clear.

meaning: 迷いから覚めること(覚めた状態);幻滅
example: The broken promise led to disillusionment.
Her claim was met with skepticism.

meaning: (人間の善良さを信じない)皮肉屋,冷笑家
example: Even a cynic could see their kindness.
He made an earnest effort to apologize.
Her expression showed the seriousness of her concern.
We were moved by the ceremony's solemnity.
